title: eos daemon configuration
description: Configuration schema for ~/.eos/config.yaml, the daemon-wide settings for the log sink registry, telemetry export, health thresholds, and log rotation. Distinct from service.yaml (see service.schema.json), which configures one registered service.

sinks.description: Named log sink registry. service.yaml's log_sinks list can reference an entry here by name instead of inlining its config.

type.description: Sink type. eos discovers the plugin binary as eos-sink-{type} on $PATH.

mode.description: Sink delivery mode: "push" sends records to a remote address, "serve" binds a local address for the remote to pull from.

address.description: Remote URL (push mode) or bind address (serve mode), passed to the plugin via the EOS_SINK_ADDRESS environment variable.

exec.description: Explicit path to the plugin binary. Overrides the eos-sink-{type} PATH lookup.

args.description: Extra arguments passed to the plugin binary.

buffer_size.description: Number of log records to buffer in memory when the plugin is slow. Oldest records are dropped on overflow. Default: 4096.

restart_delay_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait before restarting a crashed plugin. Default: 5000.

streams.description: Which output streams to route to this sink. Default: both stdout and stderr.

options.description: Plugin-specific configuration. Passed to the plugin as JSON via the EOS_SINK_OPTIONS environment variable. eos does not validate this field.

telemetry.description: OTLP export of daemon metrics and traces. Disabled by default: eos never dials a collector unless enable is true.

enable.description: Enable OTLP export. Requires endpoint to be set.

endpoint.description: OTLP collector endpoint. Required when enable is true.

insecure.description: Disable TLS when dialing the OTLP endpoint.

checkIntervalMs.description: How often, in milliseconds, the health monitor samples each running service. Default: 2000.

memSampleIntervalMs.description: How often, in milliseconds, the health monitor samples RSS memory for restart-threshold decisions. Default: 30000.

backoff.description: Exponential backoff applied between automatic service restarts.

baseMs.description: Initial restart backoff delay, in milliseconds. Default: 300.

maxMs.description: Ceiling on the restart backoff delay, in milliseconds. Must be greater than baseMs. Default: 60000.

memory.description: Memory-usage thresholds, as a fraction of a service's memory_limit_mb (0 < value < 1), that trigger warnings and automatic restarts. Must be ascending: warningThreshold < softRestartThreshold < forceRestartThreshold.

warningThreshold.description: Fraction of memory_limit_mb at which eos logs a warning. Default: 0.75.

softRestartThreshold.description: Fraction of memory_limit_mb at which eos gracefully restarts the service. Default: 0.85.

forceRestartThreshold.description: Fraction of memory_limit_mb at which eos force-kills and restarts the service. Default: 0.95.

log.description: Daemon-wide log rotation defaults, applied to a service's stdout/stderr log unless it overrides them in service.yaml (log_max_files, log_file_size_limit_bytes).

maxFiles.description: How many rotated stdout/stderr log files to keep per service (active file plus this many rotated siblings). Default: 5.

fileSizeLimitBytes.description: Rotate a service's stdout/stderr log once it reaches this size, in bytes. Default: 10485760 (10MB).
